title: Airy Sweet Portuguese Egg Tart
description: A traditional Portuguese dessert featuring a flaky crust, a creamy egg custard, and a caramelized sugar topping, now with a low-carb twist and a meringue nest, all grilled to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the almond flour, granulated sweetener, and melted butter to form a crumbly crust.
Press the crust mixture into a tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
Pour the egg mixture into the crust and smooth the top.
Grill the tart on the robata grill for 20 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown.
While the tart is grilling, prepare the meringue topping by spreading it into nest-like shapes on a baking sheet.
Once the tart is done, top it with the meringue nests and grill for an additional 2 minutes, or until the meringue is golden brown.
Remove the tart from the grill and let it cool to room temperature.
Serve the tart chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of granulated sweetener.
